notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b003:l001: Жөлөнүп describes the rider or horse traveling bent or leaning; the exact subject is compressed across the chase description.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b003:l013: Жөө туман literally 'walking fog' may be dust raised close to the ground by the racers.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b003:l025: Karagul’s thought calls the possible scout ит, 'dog'; the insult is preserved contextually.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b003:l031: Какандап is treated as the battle cry 'Kakan'; it may instead describe invoking or shouting for the Kakan.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b005:l016: Көзү төрт болуп is an idiom of desperate longing or watchfulness, literally 'his eyes becoming four.'
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b005:l019: Калдаңдады describes Karagul’s floundering, dangling, or frantic motion; the exact gait is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b005:l034: Карып калган табың жок says Algara’s condition is not aged or worn; the syntax is compressed.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0032:b005:l035: Чымындай жан is Karagul’s self-description, literally his 'fly-sized life.'
